subtitle: 按意思找片段，索引记住自己从哪来

question.zh-CN: 为默认片段建 Embedding 索引（已有且没过期就复用），再用一条同义改写的查询做向量检索。
question.en: Build an embedding index of the default chunks (reuse it if it exists and is not stale), then run vector search with a paraphrased query.

question.zh-CN: 在同一查询集上并列比较向量检索和 BM25 的命中与漏检。
question.en: Compare hits and misses of vector retrieval and BM25 side by side on the same query set.

question.zh-CN: 把维度从 256 改成 512，检查旧索引会不会被误用，再按新维度建索引。
question.en: Change the dimensions from 256 to 512, check that the old index is not used by mistake, then build an index at the new size.

exercises.title: 资料改了：旧索引不能用

question.zh-CN: 让 2025 年版开放时间下线，检查旧索引会不会被误用，再为新资料建索引。
question.en: Take the 2025 opening hours offline, check that the old index is not used by mistake, then build an index for the new documents.
